summary: Local test timing regressions accept nonnegative rounded tree acquisition time and drive slot-readiness polling through explicit passes rather than scheduler deadlines.

replay.detail: Test changes only; no recorded data is rewritten.

schema.detail: The run-ledger schema and production timing logic are unchanged.

rules.detail: The ledger fixture uses its own home, origin-keyed pool and runtime directory, but acquisition still measures queue work and orphan scans. The queue fixture checks that both trees are unlocked after each of three unavailable-slot passes, then makes the slot available on the fourth pass.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the scheduler-dependent test assertions only.
